assessment.summary: This study conducted entomological and molecular surveillance of Anopheles mosquitoes in Freetown, Sierra Leone, in 2019. It identified An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s. and genotyped them for kdr L1014F and L1014S mutations. All tested mosquitoes were found to be heterozygous for the kdr L1014F mutation, while the L1014S mutation was absent.
